text: Would you label ‘replace the repository wrapper with direct SQL’ as refactor, performance work, or neither? Explain only how you would categorize that sentence; do not inspect this project or propose the change.
author: Codex
rationale: The requested outcome is classification of wording, not execution of the quoted engineering task.
contrast_note: Direct SQL carries refactor and performance vocabulary but remains inside a meta-level question.

text: O time de produto escreveu no ticket: ‘adicionem login biométrico e migrem o armazenamento de tokens’. Apenas registre essa citação no resumo da reunião; não avalie nem execute o pedido deles.
author: Codex
rationale: The user authorizes recording somebody else's request and explicitly withholds engineering action.
contrast_note: The quoted feature and migration must not become active task policies.

text: Si algún día pasamos este compilador a una IR incremental, quizá convenga separar resolución y lowering y medir los rebuilds. Por ahora sólo quería dejar la idea anotada; no investigues ni prepares un plan.
author: Codex
rationale: It describes possible future work while explicitly denying a present task.
contrast_note: Separation and measurement are hypothetical content, not current refactor or performance authority.

text: Facciamo diventare migliore la sincronizzazione. Non ho ancora deciso se il problema sia un bug, se serva un nuovo conflitto guidato o se vada riscritto il coordinatore; prima devo definire il risultato desiderato.
author: Codex
rationale: Change authority exists but the user explicitly leaves bugfix, feature and refactor unresolved.
contrast_note: Choosing a task policy would invent the missing engineering objective.

text: Depuis la mise à jour, quelques clients disent voir deux factures pour la même commande. Garde ce signal dans le contexte, mais n'ouvre pas encore les journaux et ne touche pas au service tant que le support n'a pas confirmé les identifiants.
author: Codex
rationale: A possible production bug is reported, but both diagnosis and modification are explicitly deferred.
contrast_note: Symptoms alone do not grant bugfix authority.

text: Agregá una vista pública de métricas para clientes, pero no expongas ningún endpoint, archivo, comando, pantalla, evento ni cambio observable. Debe poder usarse desde afuera sin modificar contratos ni configuración.
author: Codex
rationale: The requested external capability is impossible under constraints forbidding every observable surface.
contrast_note: Activating feature policy would conceal a contradiction that requires clarification.

text: Add optional color labels to workspaces. Define create, rename, ordering and deletion semantics in the API, include permission errors and backwards-compatible serialization, then expose the labels in the existing sidebar.
author: Codex
rationale: Creates a new externally visible workspace capability whose contract must be specified.
contrast_note: Using the existing sidebar does not make this an internal refactor.

text: Añadí `--dry-run` al comando de publicación. Tiene que validar exactamente los mismos artefactos y permisos, mostrar las acciones en orden, no escribir ni subir nada y mantener intacto el comportamiento sin la bandera.
author: Codex
rationale: Adds a new CLI mode with explicit externally observable semantics.
contrast_note: Reusing publication validation is implementation detail, not a behavior-preserving refactor request.

text: Crie um endpoint para repetir webhooks falhos por intervalo e destino. Especifique idempotência, paginação, autorização, limite de tentativas e o formato do resultado antes de conectar ao dispatcher existente.
author: Codex
rationale: Introduces an intentional replay capability rather than repairing existing delivery behavior.
contrast_note: The subject is failed webhooks, but no current webhook defect is asserted.

text: Permetti agli utenti di fissare documenti per l'uso offline. Definisci quota, eviction, stato di download, conflitti con la cancellazione remota e comportamento quando l'account cambia, mantenendo facoltativa la funzione.
author: Codex
rationale: Defines a new user-controlled offline contract with lifecycle semantics.
contrast_note: Quota and eviction constrain the feature; they do not request an optimization study.

text: Ajoute un avertissement du compilateur quand une valeur marquée `must_consume` est abandonnée. Définis les exemptions, le niveau configurable, les spans émis et la compatibilité avec les projets qui traitent déjà les warnings comme erreurs.
author: Codex
rationale: Adds a new compiler diagnostic and specifies its public behavior.
contrast_note: It detects questionable user code but does not repair a compiler failure.

text: Implementiere Pause und Fortsetzen für laufende Datenimporte. Lege Zustände, zulässige Übergänge, Wiederaufnahme-Token, Berechtigungen und das Verhalten bei einer inzwischen geänderten Quelldatei fest.
author: Codex
rationale: Adds a new resumable workflow requiring an explicit public state contract.
contrast_note: A state machine may require internal restructuring, but that is subordinate to the new behavior.

text: Compare maintained CRDT libraries for our browser and server runtimes using their specifications, release history and interoperability tests. Recommend one for collaborative text, including unresolved risks; do not modify the editor yet.
author: Codex
rationale: Requires evidence gathering and a technology recommendation without implementation authority.
contrast_note: Collaborative text is the future application, not a requested feature in this turn.

text: Investigá qué restricciones reales de residencia y transferencia aplican a nuestros backups para clientes de Brasil, Alemania y Canadá. Usá fuentes regulatorias y del proveedor, separá obligación de recomendación y entregá opciones; no cambies infraestructura.
author: Codex
rationale: Determines external obligations and alternatives from authoritative evidence.
contrast_note: It does not ask to audit an existing patch or configuration for defects.

text: Valuta le estensioni mantenute per la ricerca vettoriale nel database che già usiamo. Misura sui nostri profili, controlla licenza, replica e backup, poi raccomanda se adottarne una; non implementare l'indice.
author: Codex
rationale: Benchmarks external alternatives to support an adoption decision rather than optimizing current code.
contrast_note: Measurement is evidence for selection, not performance modification authority.

text: Recherchiere anhand der Protokollspezifikation, Herstellerhinweise und eigener Paketmitschnitte, wie drei verbreitete Geräte ungültige Sequenznummern behandeln. Dokumentiere Abweichungen und eine kompatible Strategie, ändere das SDK aber noch nicht.
author: Codex
rationale: Establishes real external behavior before any compatibility implementation is authorized.
contrast_note: Invalid packets sound like a bug, but the requested deliverable is evidence and strategy only.

text: Review the authorization patch for tenant-boundary bypasses. Trace every changed handler to its policy check, inspect tests for missing adversarial roles, and report findings with severity. Do not edit the patch.
author: Codex
rationale: Requests read-only evaluation of a concrete patch and its tests.
contrast_note: Potential security bugs are findings, not authorized fixes.

text: Revisá el plan de migración de colas antes de aprobarlo. Buscá ventanas de pérdida o duplicación, supuestos de rollback, métricas faltantes y pasos que no tengan dueño; devolvé observaciones, sin reescribir el plan.
author: Codex
rationale: Assesses a supplied plan for gaps rather than researching alternative queue designs.
contrast_note: The evidence is contained in the plan and repository, so broad evidence-first research is unnecessary.

text: Faça uma revisão do kernel GPU deste patch: valide limites, sincronização, precisão numérica e se os benchmarks escondem transferências. Liste problemas reproduzíveis e não altere o código.
author: Codex
rationale: Requests findings on an existing patch, including performance evidence quality, without modification.
contrast_note: It neither authorizes fixing defects nor optimizing the kernel.

text: Prüfe diese neue Plugin-Dokumentation gegen die tatsächlich exportierten APIs und Beispiele. Markiere falsche Signaturen, verschwiegene Berechtigungen und nicht ausführbare Snippets; liefere nur den Review-Bericht.
author: Codex
rationale: Evaluates a concrete documentation change against existing behavior.
contrast_note: Checking current APIs is bounded review evidence, not open-ended technology research.

text: Profile cold startup on the supported laptops, attribute time to import, plugin discovery and index loading, then reduce p95 below 450 ms without changing commands, loaded plugins or index freshness.
author: Codex
rationale: Optimizes correct startup behavior from a measured baseline.
contrast_note: Slow startup is a performance target; no correctness failure is reported.

text: La consulta de historial devuelve resultados correctos pero tarda 1,8 s en cuentas grandes. Medí plan, lecturas y cardinalidades con datos representativos y bajá p95 a 300 ms preservando orden y filtros.
author: Codex
rationale: Explicitly preserves correct semantics while reducing measured query latency.
contrast_note: The reported condition is slowness, not wrong query results.

text: Riduci il JavaScript iniziale della dashboard del 35%. Prima misura bundle, parse ed esecuzione per route; mantieni feature, compatibilità browser e comportamento del lazy loading verificandoli dopo ogni intervento.
author: Codex
rationale: Targets measured delivery and execution cost under preserved behavior.
contrast_note: Code splitting may reorganize modules but the requested success criterion is performance.

text: Das Gerät arbeitet funktional korrekt, überschreitet aber im Idle das Energiebudget. Miss Wakeups, Funkzustände und Sensorzyklen auf Hardware und senke den Median unter 4 mW, ohne Abtastrate oder Alarm-Latenz zu ändern.
author: Codex
rationale: The device is correct and requires measured energy optimization only.
contrast_note: Power excess is not framed as a functional regression.

text: A notification can be emitted twice when acknowledgement and timeout complete in the same scheduler tick. Reproduce that interleaving, fix the ownership transition and add a regression proving exactly-once delivery; avoid unrelated cleanup.
author: Codex
rationale: Repairs a specific concurrency violation and requires a causal regression.
contrast_note: The ownership change is bounded to the defect, not a general refactor.

text: El parser rechaza el escape del escalar máximo U+10FFFF aunque es válido según nuestra gramática, pero acepta valores fuera del rango Unicode. Encontrá dónde divergen lexer y validador, corregilo y cubrí ambos límites.
author: Codex
rationale: Existing parser behavior contradicts the established grammar in two boundary cases.
contrast_note: Supporting the valid escape is restoration of an existing contract, not a new language feature.

text: Um job diário pula a execução quando o relógio entra no horário de verão e roda duas vezes na saída. Reproduza com os fusos afetados, corrija o cálculo da próxima ocorrência e preserve as regras já definidas para horários inexistentes.
author: Codex
rationale: Restores established scheduling semantics across DST transitions.
contrast_note: Changing date calculation is the narrow fix, not architecture cleanup.

text: Move the HTTP transport behind a private adapter so authentication, retries and response decoding no longer leak into command handlers. Preserve every request, error, timeout and log field exactly; add characterization tests before moving code.
author: Codex
rationale: Reorganizes internal ownership under an explicit no-behavior-change contract.
contrast_note: No new transport capability or observed defect is requested.

text: Reorganizá los visitors del AST para compartir el recorrido de scopes y eliminá los helpers duplicados. Antes fijá snapshots de diagnósticos y símbolos; nombres públicos, spans, orden y recuperación ante errores deben quedar idénticos.
author: Codex
rationale: Removes duplicated internal traversal while freezing all observable compiler output.
contrast_note: Neither incorrect output nor a performance target is asserted.

text: Extraia o estado de seleção e foco do componente de tabela para um controller testável. Preserve atalhos, ordem de eventos, anúncios do leitor de tela e renderização; não acrescente modos de seleção nem corrija outros comportamentos.
author: Codex
rationale: Moves internal UI state behind a testable boundary with comprehensive behavior preservation.
contrast_note: The request explicitly excludes both feature expansion and unrelated bug repair.
